department: Department of Earth Sciences (Ottawa-Carleton Geoscience Centre)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Not stated; the department site could not be reached. Students enrol at the university where their supervisor holds an appointment.

funding.value: You are automatically considered for funding (TA, research stipend, scholarships) when you apply; any offer comes with the admission letter, with no guaranteed amount stated.
funding.quote: When submitting an application for admission to Carleton, students are automatically considered for funding and if eligible, will be notified in the Offer of Admission and Funding.

entry_route.value: A master's with a minimum GPA of 9.0 is normal; exceptional bachelor's graduates (GPA 9.0 in the final two years) may be admitted directly.
entry_route.quote: the normal requirement for admission into the Ph.D. program is a master's degree with a minimum GPA of 9.0 | exceptional applicants holding a bachelor's degree, with demonstrated potential for independent thought and advanced research, with a minimum GPA of 9.00 in the final two years may be directly admitted to the Ph.D. program
